scope: macOS arm64 executor process sampler correctness and focused package gates; no throughput or helper-footprint measurement

host.source: Same-session read-only uname captured in pinned kernel provenance.

diagnostics.allocation: Successful observations and recovered RSS retries add no failure-detail String allocation.
diagnostics.join_failure_detail: Cancelled or panicked class only; no panic payload.
diagnostics.per_job_propagation: One bounded first diagnostic per affected job, using existing native Completion.error and executor error context.

guarantees.fresh_identity: Unreadable paired RSS becomes exiting metadata only after a fresh BSD observation matches the selected precise birth and carries native INEXIT; stale selection flags do not suffice.
guarantees.precedence: Birth replacement and positively observed zombie state take precedence over INEXIT. Readable paired identity/RSS remains a readable sample.
guarantees.incomplete_rss: Exiting metadata has no synthetic RSS value. Any aggregate containing it is incomplete and cannot replace the previous complete memory peak.
guarantees.retained_ownership: Exact birth and selected ancestry remain tracked, including newly discovered descendants through an exiting parent.
guarantees.occupied_process_count: Every attributed exiting process still counts against the full process reservation.
guarantees.readable_lower_bound: Readable components remain a memory lower bound and can still trigger the memory limit while another owned RSS is unavailable.
guarantees.leases: Exit progress does not release or reduce any job, host, helper, scope or retained ownership lease. Existing native wait and cleanup remain the release boundary.
guarantees.ordinary_unknown: Unreadable live identity without fresh authoritative exit progress still receives at most the existing one RSS retry, then fails closed and cancels only its affected owner.
guarantees.learning_and_growth: Incomplete per-job RSS does not feed a smaller cost or target growth. Current adaptive learning and target updates do not consume ObservedUsage or CommandOutput peak memory.
guarantees.completed_exit: INEXIT, nonzero-argument BSD visibility, TaskAllInfo failure and elapsed time do not prove task termination, reclaimed RSS, completed descendants or refundable capacity.

unchanged_contracts.topology: One shared full-host BSD topology scan, with paired RSS reads selected for owned roots and descendants.
unchanged_contracts.changes: Private sampler metadata, monitor handling, bounded diagnostics and diagnostic formatting helpers only.

regression_coverage.protects: Bounded calls, ordinary uncertainty, and fresh initial or retried INEXIT progress.
Birth replacement and zombie/absence precedence over progress.
Stale flags cannot excuse unknown memory, while readable RSS remains authoritative.
Positive same-birth zombie observation before reap and clean sampling after reap.
Exact ownership/ancestry, incomplete peak retention, and readable lower-bound enforcement.
Exiting processes remain occupied and descendants count against the limit.
Ordinary unknown observations retain identities and fail only their affected job, with bounded diagnostic propagation.
